Florence I.

"BEST DECISION EVER!"

I double cleansed my face every night and used a natural moisturiser after. It took some time but eventually my acne ... I double cleansed my face every night and used a natural moisturiser after. It took some time but eventually my acne and the scars faded. The only downside was my skin got pretty dry (causing a little rash of eczema) so I only used the black soap for my face and the turmeric for my body. UNEXPECTEDLY, The soap even cleared any ingrown hairs around my bikini line. WHAT A BONUS! All in all, this doesn’t mean that I don’t still get the occasional pimple, because yes I do. But that’s okay cause my skin has improved massively. About the product: African Black soap- Big and soft with no distinct smell. Lasts quite a while even with daily use. Turmeric soap- Smaller than the black soap also harder and has a nice citrusy smell. Runs out quit fast if used daily A big thanks to Earthly Derm!
Nazma B

"This soap is a God send"

I suffer from a skin condition called acne vulgaris. I've had this condition since I was a child, and have tried ever... I suffer from a skin condition called acne vulgaris. I've had this condition since I was a child, and have tried every medicine, blood test, diet you name is to help with acne, inflammation and hyperpigementation. My face and back are the worst for acne, once I get one spot the dark marks flood in. In June, I noticed my acne start to flare up and after 2 years of flawless clear skin I started getting spots and dark marks again rapidly. My face and whole was covered in a month, I was depressed, afraid to go outside and show my face because it looked so bad. Ive had skin issues all my life, and im so tired of it being a constant battle, having afro curly hair is already hard enough. But, this flare up all happened while I was on holiday in Korea - the best place in the world for skincare and beauty products - I paid $400 for a facial and spent $250 on skincare products to help with the hyperpigmentation - the products and facial helped with the flare up for a day. Safe to say nothing I did out there worked. I was at a loss, I'd tried everything- medicine no longer worked and my dermatologist appointment was 6 months away. Then I came across Earthly Derm, thought "oh paying more than $5 for soap is a bit much, but might aswell try it" - I mean it's just soap right? Boy was I wrong, this soap is worth the wonga. In a month my chest has near enough all cleared up, my back and face need a bit more time (they're my most stubborn areas for dark marks) but the marks have lightened and my skin is less enflamed. Honestly, I didn't think my skin would ever heal and that I'd never find a natural remedy that works but this soap has changed my life & I can't wait to see how it works when I use it for more than a month - if you're thinking "oh I don't wanna pay $$$ for soap" trust me when I say these reviews do not lie this soap is a God send. This is coming from someone who's suffered with acne and dark marks for over 15+ years, not even the doctors could help but this soap does.

ingredients.heading: How do the ingredients work?
ingredients.html:
How do the ingredients work?

CLEARS BREAKOUTS AT THE SOURCE

Cocoa Pod Ash

The active heart of the bar. Its natural cleansing and antibacterial properties lift the oil and dead skin that clog pores, then clear the bacteria that turns them into breakouts.

DEEPLY CLEANS WITHOUT STRIPPING

Shea Butter & Coconut Oil

Most cleansers that fight acne leave skin dry and tight. Shea butter and coconut oil keep your skin balanced and hydrated while the bar does its work.

CALMS IRRITATED, BREAKOUT-PRONE SKIN

Moringa Oil

Rich in antioxidants, it soothes inflammation and helps keep angry, breakout-prone skin calm and comfortable.

CLEANSES DEEP INTO PORES

Palm Kernel Oil

Creates the bar's rich, active lather that lifts the excess oil, dirt and dead skin out of your pores, clearing the buildup that leads to breakouts.

faqs.heading:
Any questions?
Let us answer them
faqs.html:
Any questions?
Let us answer them

Turmeric or Black - Which is right for me?

Turmeric Glow Bar → Brightening & Even Skin Tone
Best for dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and dull skin. It evens out complexion, boosts radiance, and gently cleanses without drying.

African Black → Acne, Blemishes & Dark Spots
Best for acne, breakouts, and post-acne marks. It deeply cleanses, controls oil, and helps fade blemishes while calming irritation.

Can I Use Both?
Yes! Many customers use Turmeric in the morning for glow & brightness, and Black Soap at night for deep cleansing & acne control.

Can this clear my acne and breakouts?

Yes. The natural plant ash lifts the oil and dead skin that clog your pores, then clears the bacteria that turns them into breakouts. So acne is dealt with at the source, not just covered up.

Will it work if nothing else has?

Most people who try this have already been through the harsh actives and washes that didn't work.

This works differently, by cleaning deep into the pores instead of stripping the surface, which is why so many who'd given up tell us it's the one that finally worked.

Can I use it every day?

Yes, once your skin is used to it. Start a few times a week, then build up to daily as your skin adjusts. Always follow with a moisturiser to keep your skin balanced.

Can I use it on my body, not just my face?

Absolutely. It works just as well on body breakouts, including the back, chest and shoulders. Lather it in your hands and massage the foam over the area, then rinse.

Will it dry my skin out?

It's a deep cleanser, so it can feel drying if you overuse it or skip moisturiser. Use a few times a week to start, and always follow with a moisturiser.

Most people find it leaves skin clean and balanced rather than tight.

What if it doesn’t work for me?

We offer a 100% money-back guarantee. If you’re not happy with your results after 60 days, contact us for a full refund.
